div.head: App AGu 2.1
div.ab: Qui furem uindicabit, sit inimicus regis et omnium amicorum eius.
2, 1. Wer einen [hingerichteten] Dieb rächen will, sei Feind des Königs und aller Freunde des letzteren.
2, 1. Whoever wishes to avenge an [executed] thief, let him be enemy of the king and of all the latter's friends.
